notes: Mid-market SaaS search/product team building a merchant product discovery layer. Initially engaged for Hosted API evaluation (fast onboarding) — ran a 2-week dev POC. Team is now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC. Very focused on reranking: want an endpoint that supports per-document features + model-side rerank, offline scoring API/SDK for nightly batch scoring, and reproducible evals. Quote from PM: "We need determinism for A/B comparators and a way to run offline rerank scoring at scale; cost/latency trade-offs matter." Prefers open model variants (Llama2-q or Falcon-quant) but flexible to Redwood curated variants. Key requirements: low tail latency for rerank calls (<80ms median, 200ms P95 for 8k qps burst?), offline batch scoring with streaming outputs, ability to pin model versions and seed RNG for deterministic runs, transparent per-token cost breakdown, and audit logs for scored items. Current in-house baseline is a lightweight BM25 + shallow transformer reranker; they need to demonstrate %NDCG lift vs baseline on 100k eval set before procurement. Cost sensitive but willing to pay for Dedicated if unit economics beat cloud GPUs in ops. Has one engineering champion (Sr. Data Engineer) and Product lead (PM).
